== Description ==
The '''SWAT Van''' ('''<u>S</u>pecial <u>W</u>eapons <u>A</u>nd <u>T</u>actics Van''') was a vehicular [[units|unit]] that could be spawned by the [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s ability, which was enabled at Level 5. The ability itself had a cooldown of 45 seconds. As with other [[units]], the '''SWAT Van''' started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map.

==Appearance==
The '''SWAT Van''' was a typical blacked-out law enforcement van, complete with bullbars, sirens and headlights. It had metal-plated tires and the word "''SWAT''" on its side, verifying that it was a '''SWAT Van'''.

== Strategy ==
*The '''SWAT Van''' is great for enemies that spawn in hordes during the round, like the [[Fallen]] or [[Glitch]].
**It is also quite useful in reducing the health of high health enemies, like the [[Shadow Boss]], [[Giant Boss]] and [[Tank]].
**Additionally, multiple '''SWAT Vans''' be used to quickly reduce the health of the [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]], since it is unlikely that the [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]] will be able to recover all of its health.
**The '''SWAT Van''' can deal full collision damage to shielded enemies, like the [[Summoner Boss]] and [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]].
*On two-pathed maps, only one '''SWAT Van''' will spawn per [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]] ability. It will go down a random path in some maps, like [[Infernal Abyss]], but may always go down one specific path in other maps, like [[Badlands]].
*You can "micromanage" the [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]] to continuously spawn '''SWAT Vans''', helping you reduce the health of major bosses, like the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]].
**This can be done by placing down an [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]], upgrading it to Level 5, using the [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s ability to spawn a '''SWAT Van''' and eventually selling it. This is repeated multiple times.
**Take note that this drains your money significantly, so you can only do this during the later stages of the game.
***If you do not have a significant amount of money, you can always repeatedly use the ability of an already placed down [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]].

== Trivia ==
*The '''SWAT Van''' was likely based on SWAT vehicles common in the United States, likely the [[wp:Lenco BearCat|Lenco BearCat]].
*The [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s ability to spawn a '''SWAT Van''' was voiced by YouTuber [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCojsj6T5tNPGPZSx7wn4coQ JOHN ROBLOX]. There were three lines:
**"''Strike force moving out.''"
**"''Strike force rolling.''"
**"''Copy, strike force is on the way.''"
